lines: A tablet on the handlebars, a laptop cast to the wall: fill the screen from any page.
The race had no Full screen button. Now it sits at the end of the bar, and in full screen it reads Exit full screen.
The class ride, Class Start, Race Setup, Results and Connect Bike gain it too: every header the mocks draw.
Where the browser has no Fullscreen API, no header offers it. The custom ride and workout used to show it anyway.
Fourteen screens, each pressed in and out, and each checked without the API.
Race Setup, from a phone to the full screen.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
